prog='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    hdiv = [i for i in range(h) if len(set(grid[i])) == 1]
    vdiv = [j for j in range(w) if len(set(grid[i][j] for i in range(h))) == 1]
    hrows = [i for i in range(h) if i not in hdiv]
    vcols = [j for j in range(w) if j not in vdiv]
    from collections import Counter
    cnt = Counter(grid[i][j] for i in hrows for j in vcols)
    bg = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells = [(i, j) for i in hrows for j in vcols if grid[i][j] != bg]
    # bands (consecutive non-divider rows) and regions (consecutive non-divider cols)
    def groups(idx):
        gs, cur = [], [idx[0]]
        for a in idx[1:]:
            if a == cur[-1] + 1: cur.append(a)
            else: gs.append(cur); cur = [a]
        gs.append(cur); return gs
    bands = groups(hrows); regions = groups(vcols)
    rb = next(b for b in bands if any(i in [x for x in b] for i, j in cells))
    rg = next(g for g in regions if any(j in g for i, j in cells))
    pat = [[grid[i][j] for j in rg] for i in rb]
    ph, pw = len(pat), len(pat[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for b in bands:
        for g in regions:
            for n, i in enumerate(b):
                for m, j in enumerate(g):
                    out[i][j] = pat[n % ph][m % pw]
    return out
'''
